sources: https://www.reservevaparks.com/Web/#!park/13 (US eDirect API prod-va-rdr.recreation-management.tylerapp.com: search/place for PlaceId 13, search/grid + search/details for all units of facilities 72 Laurel Ridge and 73 Redbud, start date 2027-05-04, read 2026-10-21)

hookups.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/holliday-lake ('Laurel Ridge Campground - (Electric and Water) - Offers 20, 30 and 50 amp hookup'; 'Redbud Campground - (Electric and Water) Offers 20 and 30-amp hookups'; 'All sites, except the group camp, have water and electric hookups') + reservevaparks.com site details (Laurel Ridge units Electric Hookup 50, Redbud 30, Water Hookup Yes), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Laurel Ridge: 6 water/electric sites for RVs up to 40 ft (the booking site lists 7, LR01-LR07, one at 50 ft) plus the tent-only group site; Redbud: 29 water/electric sites for tents, trailers, vans and pop-ups up to 30 ft (booking site vehicle lengths 18-30 ft, 8 pull-throughs). Bring extra leveling blocks at Redbud. All sites site-specific.

sites.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/holliday-lake ('Total sites of each type : Laurel Ridge: 6 sites; Redbud: 29 sites; Group Site, 1', 'Laurel Ridge is well-suited for RVs up to 40 feet long, and Redbud allows ... up to 30 feet long') + reservevaparks.com grid (Redbud 21 Back In, 8 Pull Through; Vehicle Length), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Bathhouses at Laurel Ridge and Redbud, each with an accessible toilet and shower. 'The closest laundry facility is in Appomattox, about 20 minutes from the park.' Boat launching free for overnight campers; seasonal boat rentals.

facilities.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/holliday-lake ('Running water and hot showers are available at the Laurel Ridge Bathhouse', 'Campground Bathhouses: Accessible toilet and shower in each', amenity list 'Camp Store/Gift Shop ... Dump Station', LAUNDRY), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 'All campsites at the park are site-specific reservations.' Reserve online (ReserveVAParks) or 1-800-933-PARK. 'Walk-in campers must follow the instructions for a one-night stay by using the green self-pay envelope and selecting a site that is unoccupied or does not have a reserved' tag. The booking site gives a 14-night maximum on every unit. Check-in 4 pm, checkout 1 pm.

booking.source: https://www.dcr.virginia.gov/state-parks/holliday-lake (Camping) + reservevaparks.com search/details ('MaxStay': 14 on all units), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed the $37 electric/water rate (all 36 RV units on the booking site, 2027-05-04) and the season (first Friday in March to first Monday of December), both already recorded. Added 50-amp (Laurel Ridge) / 30-amp (Redbud) with water, 35 sites to 40 ft with 8 pull-throughs, showers/dump/store, no laundry, walk-ins by self-pay envelope, 14-night max. Window/cutoff left inherited. Sewer not set: one Laurel Ridge unit (LR01) lists a sewer hookup on the booking site; DCR describes all sites as electric and water.
flags: Temporary access note (not a closure): DCR says Holliday Lake Road between Hwy 24 and the park is closed Sep 11 - Nov 20 for bridge construction; use Hollywood Road.
